Certainly! Here are two hints for the given problem step:

Hint 1: Consider the properties of the mean and median in relation to minimizing different types of errors. The mean minimizes the sum of squared errors (MSE), while the median minimizes the sum of absolute errors (MAE).

Hint 2: Think about how outliers in the data might affect the mean and median. The mean is more sensitive to outliers, which can increase the MSE, whereas the median is more robust to outliers and can result in a lower MAE.
